name: Curse
source:
Two hundred years ago after the war a contract with the demons was signed. But now contract expires, so humans send a wise emissary to prolong the contract. Demon agrees on humans terms if he is shown the power of love on example of princess Milia who turns 16 now. Four princes offer themselves as spouses and compete for 10 days after the birthday. Will the contract be signed?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-july-2008-kara-no-shoujo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
